annotations.title: Find a token by name or ticker (unverified proposals)

description: UNVERIFIED proposals for a name or ticker on one chain. `sources` picks where candidates come from: "onchain" (the default; this endpoint performs no RPC, so it answers onchain_discovery_unavailable with the SDK call to run on your RPC) or "centralized", an explicit opt-in to two third-party, centralized indexes (CoinGecko, Dexscreener search) that returns the addresses they propose and which index proposed each. No RPC and no chain read here: nothing about a candidate is checked, the proposals are not ranked by liquidity, none is labelled and none is chosen. An index that fails is named in failedSources. N tokens use a ticker, impostors copy tickers, and liquidity is not safety: the answer carries `verify`, how to read each candidate on your own node before using it.

chain.description: base | eth | optimism | arbitrum | robinhood, or a numeric chain id

query.description: a name or ticker, for example PEPE

sources.description: onchain (default; runs on your RPC through findToken of @blazephoenix/sdk/find, not here) | centralized (CoinGecko and Dexscreener search, third-party indexes)

name: find_token
